title: S8 Governed Classification Assignment
test_intent: Verify that classification values required for a declared information use resolve through a governed classification system/code set and are carried through the governed parameter or data-carrier mapping.

applicability.applies_when: The project information requirements declare classification for a model/content scope or a governed mapping rule applies to the tested content.
applicability.not_applicable_when: No classification requirement applies to the tested scope under S2/project declarations.

required_evidence: Applicable mapping rule or project declaration
Observed classification value/reference on tested content

result_logic.pass: Every applicable tested item carries a classification value that resolves to the declared governed system/code set through the applicable governed mapping/carrier rule.
result_logic.fail: An applicable item lacks the required classification, uses an uncontrolled/conflicting system or code, or stores the classification outside the governed carrier without an approved deviation.
result_logic.not_applicable: The tested scope has no declared classification requirement.
result_logic.indeterminate: The project declares classification but the applicable system, code set, mapping rule, carrier, or source requirement cannot be resolved.

provenance.derived_from: page 4423719 Classification Registry & Protocol Governance Scaffold; REQ-S8-007
provenance.migration_note: Derived from VC-001 concept and S8 classification consistency requirement. No classification system or code list is assumed as mandatory.
